items.title: Microsoft Entra ID Introduces Continuous Access Evaluation for High-Risk Sessions
items.summary: Microsoft has expanded Continuous Access Evaluation (CAE) to cover high-risk sign-in sessions, enabling near real-time policy enforcement without requiring re-authentication. The update allows organisations to revoke access tokens within seconds of detecting anomalous behaviour, closing the window attackers exploit between token issuance and expiry.

items.title: Passkey Adoption Surges Past 1 Billion Accounts as Enterprises Retire SMS OTP
items.summary: The FIDO Alliance reports passkey adoption has crossed 1 billion accounts globally, driven by expanded platform support from Google and Apple. Enterprises are rapidly deploying passkeys as a replacement for SMS OTP, with phishing resistance and reduced helpdesk load cited as primary motivators. WebAuthn Level 3 specification is expected to finalise by Q3 2026.

items.title: NIST SP 800-207A Draft: Zero Trust Architecture Guidance for Multi-Cloud Deployments
items.summary: NIST has published a draft of SP 800-207A extending the original Zero Trust Architecture guidance to address multi-cloud and hybrid deployments. The draft introduces a cloud-agnostic policy decision point model and provides reference architectures for identity-centric zero trust across AWS, Azure, and GCP simultaneously. Public comment period closes July 15.

items.title: North Korean Lazarus Group Exploits SAML Assertion Forgery in Enterprise SSO Attack
items.summary: Security researchers have attributed a sophisticated supply chain attack to Lazarus Group, leveraging SAML assertion forgery to pivot from a compromised IdP into downstream SaaS applications. The attack bypassed MFA by hijacking federated sessions post-authentication, affecting an estimated 40 enterprise customers of a major SSO provider.

items.title: EU eIDAS 2.0 Digital Identity Wallet: Implementation Deadline Looms for Member States
items.summary: European Union member states face a deadline to begin rollout of eIDAS 2.0-compliant digital identity wallets by Q4 2026. The regulation mandates citizens can use government-issued digital identities for online public and private sector services. Industry groups warn that interoperability between national wallet implementations remains a significant unsolved challenge.

items.title: Auth0 Launches Fine-Grained Authorization Engine — General Availability
items.summary: Okta's Auth0 has moved its Fine-Grained Authorization (FGA) engine into general availability, enabling developers to implement relationship-based access control (ReBAC) at scale. The service is based on Google Zanzibar and supports up to 100M permission checks per second, with SDKs for Node.js, Python, Go, and Java.

items.title: CyberArk Privilege Cloud Extends PAM to Kubernetes and Cloud-Native Workloads
items.summary: CyberArk has released a major update to Privilege Cloud extending privileged access management to Kubernetes service accounts, AWS IAM roles, and Azure managed identities. The update introduces automated secret rotation for cloud-native workloads and JIT access for ephemeral compute environments, reducing standing privilege across hybrid infrastructure.

items.title: SailPoint Acquires AI Startup to Automate Identity Governance Access Reviews
items.summary: SailPoint has announced the acquisition of an AI-powered access certification workflow startup, aiming to cut review time by 70%. The integration will allow SailPoint IdentityNow to auto-certify low-risk access while escalating high-risk entitlements, with the AI surfacing anomalous role assignments for human review.

items.title: Ping Identity Unveils Neo: Agentic AI Platform for Autonomous Access Decisions
items.summary: Ping Identity has announced Neo, an agentic AI platform that makes autonomous, context-aware access decisions in real time. Neo analyses user behaviour, device posture, network context, and peer-group norms to dynamically adjust session privileges without requiring static policy rules.

items.title: Okta Releases Workforce Identity Cloud Update with Device Assurance Enhancements
items.summary: Okta's latest Workforce Identity Cloud release strengthens device assurance policies, allowing admins to require hardware-backed key attestation and enforce managed device certificates before granting access to sensitive applications. The update also adds support for FIDO2 security keys as a primary factor.

items.title: The State of Identity Security 2026 — CrowdStrike & IDSA Annual Report
items.summary: The Identity Defined Security Alliance's annual survey of 500 security leaders finds that 84% of organisations suffered an identity-related breach in the past year. The report highlights the growing attack surface from machine identities, with non-human accounts now outnumbering human accounts 45:1 in the average enterprise. Key recommendations include continuous identity posture management and just-in-time access as highest-priority controls.

items.title: Gartner Magic Quadrant for Access Management 2026
items.summary: Gartner's 2026 Magic Quadrant for Access Management evaluates 16 vendors across completeness of vision and ability to execute. Leaders include Microsoft, Okta, and Ping Identity. The report notes a market shift toward identity fabric architectures and AI-native policy engines. Vendors who fail to address non-human identity management are increasingly penalised in evaluation criteria.

items.title: Zero Trust Maturity Model v2.1 — CISA Updated Framework
items.summary: CISA has released version 2.1 of the Zero Trust Maturity Model, adding a new 'Optimal' tier for identity pillar implementation. The update provides detailed guidance on continuous authentication, identity threat detection, and privileged access governance. Federal agencies are required to achieve 'Advanced' maturity by FY2027.

items.title: Forrester Wave: Privileged Identity Management Q2 2026
items.summary: Forrester's Q2 2026 Wave for Privileged Identity Management evaluates CyberArk, BeyondTrust, Delinea, and seven other vendors. CyberArk and BeyondTrust lead as Strong Performers. The report identifies cloud-native PAM and secrets management for DevOps pipelines as the fastest-growing evaluation criteria, reflecting the explosion of non-human identities in modern environments.

items.title: SANS 2026 Identity & Access Management Survey: Gaps in Privileged Access Controls
items.summary: The SANS Institute's annual IAM survey of 1,200 practitioners reveals that 61% lack full visibility into privileged accounts across hybrid environments. The survey highlights credential-based attacks as the top initial access vector for the fourth consecutive year. Only 38% of respondents have implemented just-in-time access, despite it being recommended as a foundational control.

items.title: Scattered Spider Returns: AI Voice Deepfakes Used to Bypass Identity Help Desks
items.summary: The Scattered Spider threat group has resumed targeting enterprise identity provider help desks using AI-generated voice deepfakes to bypass identity verification and trigger SIM swaps and MFA resets. At least six Fortune 500 companies were targeted in May 2026. Security teams are advised to implement callback verification with out-of-band authentication for all identity resets.

items.title: CVE-2026-29113 — Active Directory Certificate Services EKU Bypass Enables Domain Takeover
items.summary: A critical vulnerability in Active Directory Certificate Services allows attackers with standard domain user privileges to request certificates with arbitrary Extended Key Usages, enabling full domain compromise. The flaw affects all Windows Server versions with ADCS deployed. Microsoft has released an out-of-band patch; CISA has added it to the Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalog.

items.title: Healthcare Giant Medaura Confirms 2.1M Patient Records Exposed via Stolen Admin Credentials
items.summary: Medaura Health confirmed a breach affecting 2.1 million patient records after attackers used stolen VPN credentials from a third-party contractor. The initial access was facilitated by the absence of MFA on the contractor portal. Attackers maintained persistence for 47 days before detection, exfiltrating names, SSNs, insurance records, and clinical notes.

items.title: Financial Services Firm Loses $18M After Credential Stuffing Attack Targets Customer Accounts
items.summary: A regional US bank disclosed that 34,000 customer accounts were compromised through a large-scale credential stuffing attack using credentials leaked from unrelated third-party breaches. Attackers bypassed SMS-based MFA by performing SIM swaps on high-value accounts. The bank is migrating to hardware token and passkey authentication following the incident.

items.title: Cloud Provider Breach: Attacker Used Compromised Service Account to Access 60 Tenants
items.summary: A cloud infrastructure provider disclosed that a threat actor compromised an over-privileged service account with cross-tenant administrative rights, gaining access to data belonging to 60 enterprise customers. The service account lacked rotation policies and had not been audited in 18 months. The incident is under investigation by CISA.

items.title: Telecom Carrier Breach Exposes 800K Identities After SSO Token Theft
items.summary: A major telecom carrier reported a breach of 800,000 employee and contractor identity records after attackers stole long-lived SSO session tokens from an unpatched identity provider instance. The stolen tokens were used to access HR systems, payroll data, and internal wikis without triggering authentication alerts.

items.title: Retailer Confirms POS Breach Traced to Phished Help Desk Agent with Admin Privileges
items.summary: A national retail chain confirmed a point-of-sale breach affecting 1.4 million payment card records, traced back to a phishing attack that compromised a help desk agent account with broad Active Directory administrative rights. The attacker used the compromised account to deploy credential-harvesting malware across 300 store systems.
